notes: The burger menu holds All Items, About, Logout and Reset App State. Its links sit in the DOM even while the menu is closed, so their presence proves nothing — click the toggle first. Logout returns to the sign-in form; Reset App State empties the cart, and the badge stops existing entirely at zero items.

Continuing from the address form with a missing field shows an error banner naming that field. Assert on the banner's message text, and remember it is the same data-test="error" element the sign-in form uses.

Clearing a search restores the full catalogue. The product-name selector matches every card, so assert to_have_count for how many results a term returns, and chain .first where a single name is asserted.

The profile page shows the signed-in customer's stored details in editable fields. Assert the fields carry the seeded account's values; do NOT save any change, because it would alter the shared demo account.

Both pages are reached from the account area and each has its own heading. They may legitimately be empty for the seeded account — assert on the page's own identity and on the presence of its list container, never on a row count that depends on data.
